ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; pixel population is >95% low-intensity (dark) with high-intensity (white) pixels restricted to water droplets and sparse localized markers.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Unified dark pixel field across both lobes. Minimal high-contrast contiguous blobs are localized at the extreme distal tips and near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 110 degrees; depth of notch is roughly 4-6% of the vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge; peak-to-valley pixel variance is most pronounced on the outer margins of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge trajectory paired with a concave upward sweep on the trailing edge, tapering to narrow, slightly rounded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Micro-clusters of high-intensity white pixels detected on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes and sporadically along the trailing edge boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned light-grey linear tracks (rake marks) observed on the medial section of the right lobe, oriented roughly horizontally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe proximal to the tip; parallel linear rake marks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly localized white pigmentation clusters at the absolute distal points of the left and right fluke lobes.
